items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a bass player for a short while who played with Earl Bostic when I was there, named George Tucker

ctx.x: A little known fact. We had a bass player for a short while who played with Earl Bostic when I was there, named George Tucker, the late George Tucker. He was there for a short while. Then Jymie Merritt came later.
But Doug Watkins was the one that was with Horace Silver when Horace Silver was there.
